notes.title: 1.6.0.1版本更新说明
notes.content:
更新内容：
1.修复了在未通关第一关解锁裁判球的前提下，在角色选择界面无法进行裁判球预览的问题。 
2.修复了于关卡6-7BOSS战在破坏平台后游戏报错的问题。
3.修复了在Loading前退出游戏，存档报错的问题
4.修复了按键设置中UI显示错位的问题。

有任何问题可联系客服QQ：4000722815反馈，我们将竭力为您解决。

notes.title: 'NeverBreakup' Coming: Get 'NB' Free Demo!
notes.content:
The long-awaited STEAM Game Festival Autumn Edition is coming soon. The NB dev team has also prepared some big gifts for all players. Please enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38531436/0fe000e847a8e7dd12ef40f2a08917d7e62f4d3e.jpg[/img]

[H3] [b] Gift 1: Updated New Demo [/b][/h3]

The demo has been available on Sep 27th! Now you can enjoy it in advance! What has been updated in this demo? 


-Add 5 characters —— you can be whatever you want to be

-Add 10 accessories ——you are the most dazzling and fashion guy

-Support high/low image quality settings

-Support Online Mode & Race Mode —— 2020 online party

-Add 2 new maps ——more challenging

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38531436/2c07193103fc7d000fa3728f60768746b5518231.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Gift 2: Bug Repair + Experience Optimization[/b][/h3]


[/b][/h3]

-Modify the penetration problem after the characters fall underwater or on ground

-Modify the problem of sub player grabbing box movement delay

-Modify the button failure problem when the character grabs the ground and switches the state

-Modify the problem of the resurrection point offset after the death

-Modify the roles moving problem when opening the menu in the game 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38531436/ba0e1cbcc01e10dea47dadb111368feccaea6657.jpg[/img]
Don't hesitate to make comments or suggestions:

Discord： https://discord.gg/EZaEMN3

Twitter： ISVR@Hlxm3
